The deck demonstrates wrapping headings, sections, text/image columns, two and three figures, a custom panel, quotations, code, mathematics, fragments and tables.

```{=html}
<iframe src="demo.html" title="Aarhus University example presentation" width="100%" height="520" loading="lazy" allowfullscreen></iframe>
```

## What the public example shows

The example is generated from `template.qmd` on every site build. All nine AU font faces are embedded as WOFF2 data URLs, so the typography and Peto decorations work without installed fonts or a font server. Public CI checks font loading and the fallback for unavailable fonts.
